commands.author: Alix-007

target.title: fix(qqbot): add timeout to remote media URL fetches
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

QQBot remote media downloads accepted HTTPS media URLs and delegated them through the platform media adapter without a request deadline. If a remote media host stalled before completing the fetch, inbound attachment handling or outbound remote-media send preparation could wait indefinitely.

## Why This Change Was Made

The shared media runtime already supports guarded media request timeouts. This PR wires QQBot's media adapter contract through to that runtime and gives `downloadFile` a 120s remote media fetch deadline while preserving the existing HTTPS and SSRF policy checks.

## User Impact

Stalled QQBot media URLs now fail and return `null` through the existing error path instead of wedging the media pipeline forever.

## Evidence

Exact head: `fb6cf168380c2894040fc279aa1bfa203b8e95e7`

Static/focused validation already on the PR:

- Focused test: `pnpm vitest run extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/file-utils.test.ts` -> 6 passed.
- Format/lint: `pnpm exec oxfmt --check --threads=1 extensions/qqbot/src/engine/adapter/types.ts extensions/qqbot/src/bridge/bootstrap.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/file-utils.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/file-utils.test.ts && pnpm exec oxlint extensions/qqbot/src/engine/adapter/types.ts extensions/qqbot/src/bridge/bootstrap.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/file-utils.ts extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/file-utils.test.ts` -> passed.
- Whitespace: `git diff --check` -> clean.
- Collision check before opening: open PR changed-files query for `extensions/qqbot/src/bridge/bootstrap.ts`, `extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/file-utils.ts`, and `extensions/qqbot/src/engine/adapter/types.ts` returned no open PRs.

## Real Behavior Proof

Local stalled HTTPS harness at exact head `fb6cf168380c2894040fc279aa1bfa203b8e95e7`:

- imported the built-in QQBot adapter from `extensions/qqbot/src/bridge/bootstrap.ts`;
- called production `downloadFile()` from `extensions/qqbot/src/engine/utils/file-utils.ts`;
- used URL `https://media.qq.com:<port>/redacted/photo.png`, so QQBot HTTPS and hostname allowlist checks stayed active;
- temporarily mapped `media.qq.com` to `198.18.0.1` and bound that RFC2544 address on loopback, matching `QQBOT_MEDIA_SSRF_POLICY.allowRfc2544BenchmarkRange`;
- started a local HTTPS server with SAN `media.qq.com`, accepted the GET, and intentionally withheld headers;
- restored `/etc/hosts`, removed the loopback alias, and removed the temporary dependency symlink after the run.

Proof limitation: TLS certificate verification was disabled only for this local self-signed harness (`NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED=0`). The proof still exercises the production QQBot helper, built-in adapter, media runtime, SSRF guard, real HTTPS/TLS connection, and production 120000ms timeout abort path.

Transcript:

```text
head=fb6cf168380c2894040fc279aa1bfa203b8e95e7
node=v22.22.0
hosts=media.qq.com->198.18.0.1
tlsSAN=media.qq.com
tlsVerification=disabled-for-local-self-signed-proof
timeoutMs=120000
url=https://media.qq.com:39289/redacted/photo.png
(node:1116712) Warning: Setting the NODE_TLS_REJECT_UNAUTHORIZED environment variable to '0' makes TLS connections and HTTPS requests insecure by disabling certificate verification.
stall-server: tls secureConnection established
stall-server: accepted GET /redacted/photo.png; withholding headers
[fetch-timeout] fetch timeout after 120000ms (elapsed 120002ms) operation=fetchWithSsrFGuard url=https://media.qq.com:39289/redacted/photo.png
stall-server: request aborted by client
[qqbot:downloadFile] FAILED url=https://media.qq.com:39289/redacted/photo.png error=Failed to fetch media from https://media.qq.com:39289/redacted/photo.png: request timed out
[qqbot:downloadFile] cause=request timed out
downloadFile.result=null
elapsedMs=123527
filesWritten=0
```

What was not tested: live QQBot traffic. No QQBot token, media ID, or secret was used.
